profile.name: Anupam Das
profile.position: Research Assistant at Viral genomic and Infection Dynamics Laboratory
profile.bio: DVM graduate and MS researcher in Microbiology and Hygiene, with research experience in molecular biology, virology, and viral genomics. My research combines experimental and computational approaches to study pathogen biology, host–pathogen interactions, and molecular mechanisms of disease. Seeking for PhD in molecular biology and related fields.
profile.researchInterests: My PhD research interests center on the molecular evolution and phylodynamics of avian and zoonotic RNA/DNA viruses — particularly reassortment, recombination, and selection pressure driving emergence in poultry-dense, high-spillover-risk regions like South Asia. I am seeking a PhD lab with strengths in viral genomics, computational evolutionary biology, and One Health surveillance, where field-derived data can be paired with rigorous bioinformatic modeling.
profile.researchPhilosophy: I approach a problem by first going to the source — the outbreak, the sample, the raw sequencing read — before trusting any downstream model. Field diagnostics taught me that clean data beats clever statistics, and computational virology taught me that a phylogeny is only as honest as the quality control behind it. I try to hold both instincts at once: hands willing to do the bench work, and a mind that stays skeptical of its own pipeline.

education.description: Thesis: Molecular detection and complete genomic characterization of fowl adenovirus (FAdV) strains circulating in poultry in Bangladesh.
5-year professional veterinary program covering infectious disease pathology, epidemiology, clinical diagnostics, and diagnostic internship.

category1.title: In Vitro & Wet-Lab
category1.subtitle: Laboratory Benchwork & Viral Culture
bullets: [bullet] Viral Isolation & Culture: Embryonated Chicken Egg (ECE) inoculation (amniotic, allantoic, CAM routes), primary cell culture maintenance, cytopathic effect (CPE) monitoring.
[bullet] Serology & Titration: Hemagglutination (HA) and HA Inhibition (HI) assays, viral infectivity titration (EID50, ELD50 calculations), indirect and sandwich ELISA assays.
[bullet] Molecular Assays: Viral DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, Reverse transcription-PCR, Real-time PCR, agarose gel electrophoresis, gel documentation.
[bullet] Biosafety & Sample Processing: BSL-2 laboratory procedures, field sample processing from poultry/livestock tissue, aseptic technique, cold-chain maintenance.

category2.title: Computational biology & Bioinformatics
category2.subtitle: Genomic and evolutionary Analysis
bullets: [bullet] NGS Genome Assembly & Annotation: Full-length viral genome assembly (SPAdes), quality filtering (FastQC, Trimmomatic), gene prediction, genome annotation (Prokka, NCBI).
[bullet] Phylogenetics & Evolutionary Dynamics: Maximum Likelihood and Bayesian phylogenetic tree construction (IQ-TREE, RAxML, MEGA, BEAST), tree visualization (FigTree, iTOL).
[bullet] Recombination & Selection Pressure: Recombination detection suite (RDP4/RDP5), site-specific selection pressure analysis (PAML).
[bullet] Vaccinology & Computational Tools: Subtractive genomics, Linux shell scripting, Python & R data visualization (Elementary).
